author: _Ben_Dover
body:
Right.. so I've just been banned for over a month for apparent "Racism". 
This was done by Eako. 
Let me get this straight.. do you even know what racism means? what acts it possesses and are required to perform and incorporate racism?? I don't think so buddy. 
Racism is
 the belief that all members of each race possess characteristics, abilities, or qualities specific to that race, especially so as to distinguish it as inferior or superior to another race or races.

So I pretty much have been banned for that.. even though i did absolutely nothing hahahah??? 
What caused this was the act upon me typing "Nig"  
The reason why i did it was simple.. people were typing rapping words like "dawg" and "yo bro" etc. So I wasn't being racist towards anyone or anything in anyway.. if anything i was embracing other culture. 

So I believe that i shouldn't have been banned for a month for that... ill be fair and let you bring it down to a week at the most. You can't just ban me and title it for something i clearly didn't do okay? Remember this for future situations. If you don't like, it then yes, of course i won't do it again, but don't over excess on this senareo because it is a simple mis-understanding and just following along with all the other members of the server who are having some good banter.

Thank you.
_Ben_Dover
P.s i didn't call anyone a "Nig" either.. i was just fitting in with the rest. At the worst you would call it Steryotypical.

title: Banned for "Racism"

replies.author: BoldAndBrash
replies.body:
Hello,

Racism was not the main reason for your ban. You have received 20 infractions since March. You've been given 20 chances, and that's enough. I was thinking of whether giving you a permanent ban or a temporary, and I chose temporary since you hadn't been given one before. The term "nig" could've been insulting to someone, while words like "dawg" wouldn't offend anyone. 

Regards,
Eako, Avicus Moderator
